name: Tourist Nights
dax: SUMX(Tourism, Tourism[Number of Tourists] * Tourism[Average Length of Stay])

name: Tourists YoY %
dax:
VAR SelectedYear = MAX(Tourism[Year])
VAR CurrentValue = CALCULATE([Total Tourists], REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate), DimDate[Year] = SelectedYear)
VAR PriorValue = CALCULATE([Total Tourists], REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate), DimDate[Year] = SelectedYear - 1)
RETURN
    DIVIDE(CurrentValue - PriorValue, PriorValue)

name: Destination Share %
dax: DIVIDE([Total Tourists], CALCULATE([Total Tourists], ALLSELECTED(Tourism[City]), ALLSELECTED(Tourism[Country])))

name: RevPAR
dax: AVERAGEX(Tourism, Tourism[Average Room Price USD] * Tourism[Hotel Occupancy Rate] / 100)

name: Revenue YoY %
dax:
VAR SelectedYear = MAX(Tourism[Year])
VAR CurrentValue = CALCULATE([Total Revenue], REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate), DimDate[Year] = SelectedYear)
VAR PriorValue = CALCULATE([Total Revenue], REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate), DimDate[Year] = SelectedYear - 1)
RETURN
    DIVIDE(CurrentValue - PriorValue, PriorValue)

name: Revenue Trend
dax:
VAR Points =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES(DimDate[Month Index]), "@y", [Total Revenue]),
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
        DimDate[Period Type] = "Actual"
    )
VAR Fit = FILTER(Points, NOT ISBLANK([@y]))
VAR n = COUNTROWS(Fit)
VAR SumX = SUMX(Fit, DimDate[Month Index])
VAR SumY = SUMX(Fit, [@y])
VAR SumXY = SUMX(Fit, DimDate[Month Index] * [@y])
VAR SumXX = SUMX(Fit, DimDate[Month Index] ^ 2)
VAR Slope = DIVIDE(n * SumXY - SumX * SumY, n * SumXX - SumX ^ 2)
VAR Intercept = DIVIDE(SumY - Slope * SumX, n)
VAR x = MAX(DimDate[Month Index])
RETURN
    IF(n > 1 && HASONEVALUE(DimDate[Year Month]), Intercept + Slope * x)

name: Revenue Forecast
dax:
VAR Points =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES(DimDate[Month Index]), "@y", [Total Revenue]),
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
        DimDate[Period Type] = "Actual"
    )
VAR Fit = FILTER(Points, NOT ISBLANK([@y]))
VAR n = COUNTROWS(Fit)
VAR SumX = SUMX(Fit, DimDate[Month Index])
VAR SumY = SUMX(Fit, [@y])
VAR SumXY = SUMX(Fit, DimDate[Month Index] * [@y])
VAR SumXX = SUMX(Fit, DimDate[Month Index] ^ 2)
VAR Slope = DIVIDE(n * SumXY - SumX * SumY, n * SumXX - SumX ^ 2)
VAR Intercept = DIVIDE(SumY - Slope * SumX, n)
VAR x = MAX(DimDate[Month Index])
VAR m = MAX(DimDate[Month Number])
VAR MonthAvg = CALCULATE(AVERAGEX(VALUES(DimDate[Month Index]), [Total Revenue]), REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate), DimDate[Period Type] = "Actual", DimDate[Month Number] = m)
VAR OverallAvg = CALCULATE(AVERAGEX(VALUES(DimDate[Month Index]), [Total Revenue]), REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate), DimDate[Period Type] = "Actual")
VAR SeasonalIndex = DIVIDE(MonthAvg, OverallAvg, 1)
RETURN
    IF(n > 1 && HASONEVALUE(DimDate[Year Month]) && MAX(DimDate[Period Type]) = "Forecast", (Intercept + Slope * x) * SeasonalIndex)

name: 2025 Revenue Forecast
dax:
SUMX(
    CALCULATETABLE(VALUES(DimDate[Year Month]), REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate), DimDate[Period Type] = "Forecast"),
    VAR CurrentMonth = DimDate[Year Month]
    RETURN
        CALCULATE([Revenue Forecast], REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate), DimDate[Year Month] = CurrentMonth)
)

name: Revenue 3M Moving Avg
dax:
VAR CurrentIndex = MAX(DimDate[Month Index])
RETURN
    IF(
        HASONEVALUE(DimDate[Year Month]) && MAX(DimDate[Period Type]) = "Actual",
        CALCULATE(AVERAGEX(VALUES(DimDate[Month Index]), [Total Revenue]), REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate), DimDate[Month Index] > CurrentIndex - 3, DimDate[Month Index] <= CurrentIndex)
    )

name: Occupancy Forecast
dax:
VAR Points =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES(DimDate[Month Index]), "@y", [Avg Occupancy %]),
        REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate),
        DimDate[Period Type] = "Actual"
    )
VAR Fit = FILTER(Points, NOT ISBLANK([@y]))
VAR n = COUNTROWS(Fit)
VAR SumX = SUMX(Fit, DimDate[Month Index])
VAR SumY = SUMX(Fit, [@y])
VAR SumXY = SUMX(Fit, DimDate[Month Index] * [@y])
VAR SumXX = SUMX(Fit, DimDate[Month Index] ^ 2)
VAR Slope = DIVIDE(n * SumXY - SumX * SumY, n * SumXX - SumX ^ 2)
VAR Intercept = DIVIDE(SumY - Slope * SumX, n)
VAR x = MAX(DimDate[Month Index])
VAR m = MAX(DimDate[Month Number])
VAR MonthAvg = CALCULATE(AVERAGEX(VALUES(DimDate[Month Index]), [Avg Occupancy %]), REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate), DimDate[Period Type] = "Actual", DimDate[Month Number] = m)
VAR OverallAvg = CALCULATE(AVERAGEX(VALUES(DimDate[Month Index]), [Avg Occupancy %]), REMOVEFILTERS(DimDate), DimDate[Period Type] = "Actual")
VAR SeasonalIndex = DIVIDE(MonthAvg, OverallAvg, 1)
RETURN
    IF(n > 1 && HASONEVALUE(DimDate[Year Month]), MIN(MAX((Intercept + Slope * x) * SeasonalIndex, 0), 1))

name: Total Visitor Spend
dax: SUMX(Tourism, Tourism[Number of Tourists] * Tourism[Tourist Spending USD])

name: Spend Share %
dax: DIVIDE([Total Visitor Spend], CALCULATE([Total Visitor Spend], ALLSELECTED(Tourism[Hotel Rating])))
